title: Hourly Auto-Dig:RAND headquarters and current-news scan
summary: Global dataset-first selection chose dark-academia and RAND. The pass adds explicit first-party Santa Monica headquarters evidence, preserves office/mail distinctions, records a bounded no-material-news result, and queues headquarters continuity plus roster recovery.

sources.title: Press Room
sources.query: RAND Corporation current organizational news and location changes, 2026-07-28 through 2026-08-19

data.research_question: What defensible public headquarters connection can be added for the globally selected RAND target, and has materially relevant current news changed RAND organizational or location facts since the July 31 roster refresh?
data.method: Refreshed current main, recent commits and hourly merges, open PRs/issues, live workflows, operating documentation, executable v0.9.0 schema, generated schema, topic manifest, RAND dataset manifest, and canonical RAND organization through the GitHub connector. Used the recorded reproducible two-stage dataset-first selection with recency, conflict, and geography exclusions. Reviewed RAND first-party contact material for exact location semantics. Only after the location slice was resolved, searched current RAND press/news and web results with overlap back to 2026-07-28. Added only material typed evidence and preserved the absence of a material current organizational-news update instead of creating filler.
classification_rules: Dataset/topic stage is approximately uniform over eligible datasets/topics and is not weighted by row count.
The previous three successful hourly datasets are hard exclusions when at least four alternatives exist.
Directly overlapping draft slices are excluded when non-conflicting alternatives exist.
The dominant geographies of the previous three successful hourly runs are avoided at target stage when alternatives exist.
Headquarters, physical delivery address, mailing address, ordinary office, affiliate/subsidiary location, and registered office remain distinct predicates.
Coordinates are omitted without a defensible geocoder or authoritative coordinate source.
Current news is ingested only when it adds a material event, correction, relationship, location change, or counterevidence.

findings.selection_algorithm: Sort the complete 54-entry dataset/topic universe; remove the previous-three successful hourly datasets and direct-conflict dataset slices; select eligible_pool[seed mod 48]. For the selected dark-academia composite, sort all 19 source-roster datasets, remove direct-conflict and previous-three-geography candidates, then select target_pool[target_seed mod 13]. Dataset size does not affect dataset-stage probability.

findings.result: RAND current first-party contact material explicitly labels Santa Monica as Headquarters and gives 1776 Main Street, Santa Monica, CA 90401-3208 for physical delivery. Separate Washington, Pittsburgh, Boston, Europe, and Australia entries are offices; no coordinates were manufactured.

Searched RAND current press/news and web results from 2026-07-28 through 2026-08-19, overlapping the July 31 roster refresh. Results were research/commentary and unrelated entities named Rand; no material post-refresh RAND corporate, governance, relationship, or headquarters change was found, so no filler news event was ingested.
